Q: C++ Double Buffer Threading A:

You have to measure. What's the total run time for 2-reads, double-buffer and hash plus update hash compared to a simple read then hash. Or, dump the assembler and take a look. Without measuring you really can't quantify an answer, but unless you save enough to justify the additional complexity, KISS should win. (Keep It Stupid Simple) [you can swap the two 'S' words for the same premise with a slightly different affect]

Q: Turing Completeness for a CPU? A:

Your logic is mixed up (reverse logic). You're saying that DotNet can be reproduced using brain-fuck. That's not point. Hypothetical processor itself is DotNet. And you need to prove via brain-fuck that this processor is Turing-complete. Impossible. You need to prove that internal implementation of DotNet is Turing-complete, but you don't have access to this (built-in-processor) internal implementation. What you use outside is not proof of inside. LAST COMM.

Q: Unlink of file Failed. Should I try again? A:

File / Folder Casing - Windows and Git

I had restarted PC and closed all programs, ran command prompt as admin and nothing worked. I had a folder that was renamed weeks ago from caps to lowercase and that was the problem. Fix was:

ren src/lib/components/UI ui

git add src/lib/components/ui

git rm--cached src/lib/components/UI

Then just git commit -m "fix folder name"

Hope this helps someone. I spent a LOT of hours on this.
